phase_name: Independent PDF requirements and fixed negative controls
limitations_en: The two user-provided PDF-derived ledgers were adopted as the common candidate inventories and checked against the actual uploaded PDF rather than independently re-extracted from a blank slate.
No source atom statements, source IDs, negative-control predicates or English evidence quotations were rewritten; the file locator was reconciled to the exact uploaded PDF filename.

All 90 pages were readable and programmatically inspected. Visual review focused on figure-only pages and key evidence figures/tables, not an exhaustive human review of every diagram and every normative predicate.

Potential overbroad parent requirements and overlapping cross-appendix test duties remain named for the protocol-designated Phase 5 source-atomization challenge; these may change the denominator then.
No generated Markdown was adjudicated, and no TP/TN/FP/FN or performance metrics are claimed in Phase 1.
